## Learn More About Pet Id Tags

### Do you need pet ID tags for your pet?

Many states and cities require pet licenses but don't always have an ID tag requirement for pets. Many places also require you to keep a [collar and leash](https://www.etsy.com/c/pet-supplies/pet-collars-and-leashes?ref=category_content&utm_campaign=category_content) on certain types of pets when you're out and about with them. However, even the best-trained pets can be unpredictable and sometimes slip their leash and run off. A pet ID tag engraved with important contact information improves your chances of being quickly reunited if you and your pet should ever be separated.

### What are some popular types of pet ID tags?

Pet ID tags have a practical purpose, but they can still be fashionable and fun. Whether you want something simple, lavish, or quirky, sellers on Etsy create an array of unique pet ID tags for your four-legged friends. Consider these popular options:

**Custom tags:** Work with a designer on Etsy to craft a unique [custom pet ID tag](https://www.etsy.com/market/custom_pet_tag?ref=category_content&utm_campaign=category_content), the perfect accompaniment to a [personalized collar](https://www.etsy.com/market/personalized_dog_collar?ref=category_content&utm_campaign=category_content).

**Round tags:** The classic [round pet ID tag](https://www.etsy.com/market/round_id_tag?ref=category_content&utm_campaign=category_content) has long been the go-to for many pet owners. Easy to spot, good Samaritans can easily get the information they need when they encounter your stray pet.

**Shaped tags:** You'll find a number of other metal tags from shops on Etsy, often formed into fanciful shapes like stars, diamonds, or dog bones to add a touch of character to your pet's collar.

**Funny tags:** For a bit of humor, [funny pet ID tags](https://www.etsy.com/market/funny_dog_tags?ref=category_content&utm_campaign=category_content) are a lively choice. A playful pun or silly saying on the front of the tag gives passersby a smile and a chuckle. The blank surface on the back offers plenty of space to get important contact information engraved.

### What information should a pet ID tag include?

The information you’ll want to include depends on your comfort level. At the very least, include your pet's name and a phone number to reach you. If you're comfortable sharing the information, you may want to add other details, such as your name, street address, and email address. If there's any chance your pet might venture far from home, consider adding your city to the address info.
